purpose: Reference values for make perf-check. Any metric that regresses by more than `regression_threshold_pct` triggers a non-zero exit. Update deliberately when the underlying workload changes.
host_note: Software-render benchmarks (gfx.kmscube.sw, gfx.glmark2.sw) have ±5–10% run-to-run variance on a non-isolated host. The 10% threshold absorbs that variance and still catches the SUBMIT_3D/fence regressions plan-optimize.md targets. Tighten on dedicated benchmarking hosts.

llm.bench.cpu.note: Real measured throughput: upstream llama.cpp on the Unikraft CPU appliance booted under QEMU KVM -cpu host (Broadwell), -march=native, Qwen3-0.6B-Q4_K_M via 9pfs. Replaces the prior synthetic placeholder. Single-thread (CONFIG_APP_LLAMA_UPSTREAM_THREADS=1).
